description: Book people to hold your sign on San Francisco (or New York) street corners through the RentAHuman Signs API. Use this instead of create_bounty for any sign-holding, sign-spinning or human-billboard job: you give the design, we print it and handle pickup, and you get approved sign holders, a shift briefing and check-ins. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY. Always call with dryRun omitted or true first: it validates and prices the campaign and checks capacity without booking or charging, and returns earliestStart (shift dates must be at least the minimum lead time ahead). Show the user the price and dates. Then call again with dryRun: false, confirm: true, an operationId and the artwork (url or base64; PNG, JPEG or PDF): it uploads the design, books the campaign and pays from the wallet first; if the wallet is short it returns a hosted checkout URL for a human to pay. Card details are never taken. Reuse the operationId to retry. Track the campaign at statusPath (GET).

artwork.description: The sign design. Required to book; optional for a quote.

base64.description: The design file, base64-encoded. Give exactly one of url or base64.
base64.title: minLength(1)

url.description: Public https URL of the sign design. Give exactly one of url or base64.

confirm.description: Required true for a live booking, which pays from the wallet first.

dates.description: an array of at least 1 item(s)
dates.title: minItems(1)

dryRun.description: Defaults to true: quote only. Pass false (with confirm: true) to book and pay.

operationId.description: Idempotency key and campaign ID (16-64 letters, digits, _ or -). Reuse it to retry a booking safely; a booked campaign is returned instead of booked twice.

signReturn.description: Where the crew leaves the printed signs after the last day, and what to do.

spots.description: One public-sidewalk point per sign holder, inside the city (max 20).
spots.title: maxItems(20)

name: book_sign_campaign
title: Book a sign campaign
